newsitem.title: CHINA: SPEEDSKATING-CHINA'S XUE AIMS FOR OLYMPIC GOLD.
newsitem.headline: SPEEDSKATING-CHINA'S XUE AIMS FOR OLYMPIC GOLD.

text.p: China's womens speed-skating star Xue Ruihong has said she is confident of a gold medal in next year's Winter Olympics, the China Sports Daily said on Wednesday.

Xue, who sped to gold in the 500 metres at the world single distance championships in Poland last month and holds China's national title, was looking to continue her medal streak through the 1998 Winter Games in Nagano, Japan, the newspaper said.
"Now I dare to say that I already have the ability to win a gold medal in the Winter Olympics," the newspaper quoted Xue as saying.

Xue had won overall shortcourse gold at China's national games with a score that bettered her silver medal performance at the world championships in Norway in February, the newspaper said but gave no further details.
